claim_boundary: This is one no-update feasibility screen on a small procedurally generated arithmetic task. It is not a training result, public benchmark score, confirmation result, evidence of general reasoning, or evidence of capability improvement. Optional calculator use means the screen measures the combined model-tool system.

compute_limits.device: CPU only; CUDA and MPS use forbidden

dataset.selection: All rows are newly generated from four declared arithmetic word-problem templates with randomized integer operands. No public dataset or benchmark split is used. The 96 rows are permanently excluded from formal training, development, and confirmation.

decision_rule: Pass only if all 96 rows complete; aggregate exact match is in [0.25, 0.85]; each family is at least 0.10; and peak RSS and wall time remain within limits. Pass means only proceed to design and separately freeze a new post-training study. Fail means retire this model/task pairing; do not adjust thresholds or reuse this pilot for training or confirmation.

generation.decoding: Greedy with the model tokenizer default EOS behavior; messages are rendered with the pinned local tokenizer chat template.
generation.prompt_template: System: Solve the arithmetic word problem carefully. You may use the provided calculator for integer arithmetic. End with the final integer inside \boxed{...}. User: exact generated problem text.
generation.response_parser: Parse the last integer in a LaTeX \boxed{integer} expression in the final non-tool assistant turn; no boxed integer is incorrect/unparsed.
generation.tool: A deterministic restricted Python-AST calculator supporting integer +, -, *, //, %, and exponentiation only for bounded operands/results.

metrics.primary: Exact match of the last boxed integer against the independently generated integer oracle across all 96 rows. Missing/invalid final parse is incorrect.
secondary: Calculator call count, valid calls, invalid/excess calls
Generated tokens, generation wall time, tokens per second
Peak resident set size, total wall time
metrics.uncertainty: Report a two-sided 95% Wilson interval for the aggregate exact-match rate; no hypothesis test or confirmatory claim.

model.model_role: base checkpoint; no finetuning or optimizer updates

purpose: Decide whether a cached CPU-runnable base model has enough measured competence and headroom on an independently verifiable, multi-step task to justify designing a separate post-training study.

task.answer_scope: Parse only the last boxed integer in the final non-tool assistant turn. Missing parse is incorrect.
task.system_prompt: Solve the arithmetic word problem carefully. You may use the provided calculator for integer arithmetic. End with the final integer inside \boxed{...}.
